epics.title: Standalone Responsive Knowledge Base & Fast Search Tool
epics.jtbd: When an educational resident, researcher, or faculty member accesses the CRIE knowledge base on desktop or mobile, I want a fast, thoughtful, self-contained search and document exploration interface without third-party integration friction, so that I can immediately find and inspect clinical, academic, and normative resources in seconds.
requirements: R1: Implement pixel-perfect UI updates matching approved design mockup design/approved/20261117154026-mockup/mockup.html in existing frontend code.

slices.title: Implement approved design mockup updates into existing frontend interface
slices.jtbd: When implementing approved design updates for this epic, I want to patch existing frontend components to match design/approved/20261117154026-mockup/mockup.html pixel-perfect, so that the knowledge base user interface accurately reflects the approved design reference.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the approved mockup at design/approved/20261117154026-mockup/mockup.html
When patching existing frontend component styles and markup to match the design reference
Then the visual presentation matches the approved mockup pixel-perfect across desktop and mobile devices without regressing search functionality.
